verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for a national IP office, since peer offices can expose programmatic search and filing interfaces, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing web portals: e-filing, public search, status tracking on iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in, and downloadable forms. None of it documents a public API, endpoints, keys or developer docs, and web portals and search pages do not count as an API.
